title: Mobile dead zones across the MRT network
asked: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song asked whether IMDA compiles a list of specific mobile network dead zones across the entire MRT network, whether that list and each site's rectification status would be made public in a dashboard, and how many persistent signal gaps have remained unrectified for more than 12 months.
response: Mr Tan Kiat How said MNOs must meet IMDA's 4G Quality of Service standards, including more than 99% mobile coverage in all MRT tunnels and stations, and that IMDA conducts regular checks. Quality of Service results for each MRT line are published on IMDA's website. Where coverage gaps are found, IMDA works with MNOs on enhancements, which typically take six months within limited tunnel maintenance windows. He added that over the last three years, no persistent signal gaps within the MRT network remained unrectified.
